hero.headline:
Count your tokens.
Like beads on an abacus.
hero.description: — monitor budgets, estimate costs, optimize context, and cut AI spending before it adds up. A VS Code extension, MCP server, and CLI that makes the invisible visible.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
steps: Install from the VS Code Marketplace or run `ext install tokalator`
Click the Tokalator icon in the Activity Bar — the sidebar dashboard opens
Type `@tokalator /count` in Copilot or Claude Chat to see your token budget
Pin important files with `/pin` so they always stay in context
Run `/optimize` to get a full health report on your context window

items.name: Price Estimation in Dashboard
items.description: Live input/output cost breakdown in the sidebar. See estimated turn cost, per-token rates, and total spend before you send a single prompt. All 17 model prices built in.

items.name: Claude Code via MCP
items.description: Real Claude BPE token counting inside Claude Code — count_tokens, estimate_budget, preview_turn, list_models via stdio MCP transport. Zero API calls.

items.name: 17 Model Profiles with Pricing
items.description: Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 Mini, GPT-5.x Codex, Gemini 3.x — each with per-MTok input/output prices. Auto-detected from VS Code Copilot chat.

items.name: Economist-Style Calculator
items.description: Redesigned cost calculator with animated horizontal bar charts, cost-at-scale table, and stacked breakdown bars. No pie charts.

items.name: Tokalator Pro
items.description: Team dashboards, historical token usage analytics, CI/CD budget gates, and custom model profiles.

items.name: Cursor Extension
items.description: Full Tokalator experience inside Cursor. Same dashboard, scoring, and chat commands — native to your workflow.

items.name: Per-Turn Budget Indicator
items.description: Live IDE status-bar widget showing estimated turns remaining before the conversation exhausts the context budget — the top community-requested feature.

items.name: Secret Scanner (/secrets)
items.description: Detect and warn when API keys, tokens, or credentials appear in open tabs before they silently enter your AI context.
